form.label: Operations and Security
form.description: Review alarms, failed tasks, authentication and infrastructure activity carried in vCenter and Aria syslog. Missing categories indicate either no activity or a forwarding/coverage gap.

div.p: Review alarms, failed tasks, authentication and infrastructure activity carried in vCenter and Aria syslog. Missing categories indicate either no activity or a forwarding/coverage gap.

search.query: `vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search category IN (alarm,availability,infrastructure) | sort 200 - _time | table _time vcenter vm_name esxi_host severity vmware_action status message
`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search category=authentication | sort 200 - _time | table _time vcenter user src_ip vmware_action status message
`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search category=security | sort 200 - _time | table _time vcenter user event_type message

`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search category=task OR status=failure | sort 200 - _time | table _time vm_name user task_id event_chain_id event_type status message
